title: money.skipped payload v1
description: A Stripe payment, refund, payout or dispute the handler applied but did not book, because it is not in USD (the postings are USD only). No postings: this event is the count. Credits for an invoice were granted as usual.

id.description: Stripe's id of the object: the invoice, the payout, the dispute, or (for a refund) the event that delivered it.

amount.description: In the currency's minor units: what the invoice paid, the refund moved, the payout sent, or the dispute was for.
